rationale: Correct the existing Hamakua Energy Plant record to the canonical Hamakua Energy identity rather than creating a duplicate. Pacific Current sold all interests in Hamakua Holdings to an indirect wholly owned Harbert Management Corporation subsidiary on March 10, 2025. Harbert owns the current platform at the parent level, but the buyer subsidiary and fund are not publicly disclosed; the existing Gulf Pacific attribution is unsupported and is removed. Preserve the prior Enserch/Jones, TECO, Energy Investors Funds, ArcLight and Pacific Current ownership history. No later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Hamakua Energy
companyFieldUpdates.description: Hamakua Energy is a 60 MW net combined-cycle power plant at Honokaʻa on Hawaiʻi Island. The facility uses two liquid-fuel combustion turbines and a waste-heat steam turbine, supplies firm capacity under a power-purchase agreement extending through 2030 and has historically provided about one-third of the island's electricity. Pacific Current, a Hawaiian Electric Industries subsidiary, sold all interests in Hamakua Holdings to an indirect wholly owned Harbert Management Corporation subsidiary on March 10, 2025. The buyer subsidiary and Harbert fund are not publicly disclosed; Gulf Pacific is not supported as an owner or vehicle. Earlier ownership included Energy Investors Funds, ArcLight Fund IV and Pacific Current. The plant remained grid-connected after an August 2026 interruption, and no later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.
